dataset.calibration: per-image CSV pixel_size; ProMax 2D conflict remains flagged

architecture.name: HRNet-W32
architecture.initialization: random; no pretrained artifact approved or downloaded
architecture.batch_norm: upstream BatchNorm; statistics use microbatch 2, not accumulated batch 8

preprocessing.coordinate_policy: normalized current API coordinates x/W,y/H; exact recorded affine and padding inverse

targets.loss: equal-landmark masked Gaussian heatmap MSE; no rounding of target center
targets.decoder: argmax cell center, inverse letterbox; no quarter-pixel shift or test-time flip
targets.confidence: raw peak is not probability; validation-only calibration is a later separate selection step

training.device: one available Colab T4 or L4; record actual GPU and hourly CCU rate
training.mixed_precision: FP16 AMP on supported CUDA hardware; record overflow/scaler events
training.full_run_lr_schedule_proposal: 5-epoch linear warmup then cosine; schedule frozen before full-run approval

augmentation_train_only.invalid_transformed_points: mask target loss; log counts, never clamp into the image

pilot_limits.prerequisites: review duplicate-exclusion policy, calibration conflict, schema/config and authorize pilot implementation
pilot_limits.stop_at: earliest limit, nonfinite loss, repeated OOM or CCU budget concern
pilot_limits.budget_enforcement: wall-time bound derived from observed Colab hourly rate with 20 percent reserve; actual CCU balance recorded separately

full_run_proposal.selection: validation only, with predefined landmark/angle failure checks
full_run_proposal.requires: completed audit, reviewed pilot time/CCU report and explicit user approval
